newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-INJURY-HIT WALES NAME SQUAD OF 26.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-INJURY-HIT WALES NAME SQUAD OF 26.

text.p: Injury-plagued Wales on Thursday named an enlarged squad of 26 for their Five Nations championship match against England at Cardiff Arms Park next week.

Fly-half Arwel Thomas has already definitely pulled out of the match because of a damaged knee and his possible replacement, veteran Jonathan Davies, has injured ribs although he hopes to be fit in time.

Also on the injured list but included in the squad are David Young (ankle), Christian Loader (knee), Rob Howley (shoulder), Gareth Thomas (ankle), Scott Gibbs (stiff neck), Ieuan Evans (hamstring) and Scott Quinnell (neck).

The Wales squad is: A.Bateman, J.Davies, N.Davies, I.Evans, S.Gibbs, R.Howley, N.Jenkins, P.John, W.Proctor, G.Thomas, P.Arnold, C.Charvis, J.Davies, J.Humphreys (captain), G.Jenkins, S.John, G.Llewellyn, C.Loader, D.McIntosh, L.Mustoe, C.Quinnell, S.Quinnell, H.Taylor, M.Voyle, B.Williams, D.Young.
